notes: Draft configuration: Figure-of-eight course follows the independently named Chicago, Hammerhead, Follow-through, Bentley, Bacharach, Gambon, Crooner and Wilson sections. The two loops meet at an actual shared source node; no edge is duplicated and no crossing or connecting coordinate is invented. This preserves the crossing that a simple-cycle search omitted. Source length 2808.1 m remains unadjusted. Branch identity was checked against catalogue layout facts and circuit identification references. Independent source distance 2808.1 m; no coordinates are changed to match a diagram or distance. Travel direction and historical alignment remain provisional.

sharedGround.note: Integers select original inner-ring vertices. Coordinate tuples are native-image anchors. Original border coordinates keep their feature-level licence; image-derived pins need their pinned imagery rights and credit. Reconstruction must keep both components as distinct grass holes, and may not turn their former connector into a road boundary.

sources.notes: The complete saved source route is followed without recentering or shortcuts. A compact source-indexed correction separates grass islands across their shared paved junction; five local image pins supplement original unverified boundary coordinates, whose feature-level licence is retained. Pins use LicenseRef-MapTiler-Derived-Borders and © MapTiler © OpenStreetMap contributors. Asphalt, boundary lines and illustrative curbs are reconstructed on demand; no mesh, imagery bytes or video is saved. Car and pavement use one world-coordinate field sampled from the unchanged approximately 80 m terrain raster, not a road survey. Every complete driving segment clears a 2.5 m radius enclosing the rendered car. Curbs are boundary-curvature illustrations with assumed dimensions and colours, not verified curb locations. Banking is unknown and assumed zero. The compressed elevation profile is a summary; runtime road heights sample the shared terrain field directly.
